notes: The longer supplied configuration retains the original northern infield course, middle eastward connector, outer southern oval arc, inner southern extension and original infield southern return. These physical branches are independently visible in pinned public-domain 2019 NAIP imagery. The operator identifies the enlarged road-course facility; the temporary paddock rectangle in the general operator plan is excluded because it is absent from this supplied configuration. Historical branch choice, direction and fine centerline alignment remain draft. Coordinates are not fitted to a private diagram or scalar distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 3117.8 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 73 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
